title: Unpacking the Evaluators: How Configuration Shapes the Evaluation of Alignment in Explainable AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.30816v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Explainable AI (XAI) evaluation fundamentally requires human-centered evaluation, assessing whether explanations align with human reasoning and expert knowledge. However, such evaluations often require expert-driven manual validation and are difficult to scale, leading to the widespread use of alignment-based metrics, where attribution maps are compared against predefined ground-truth (GT) representations. Despite their popularity, alignment evaluations are implicitly bias towards multiple design choices made during the evaluation process, for example GT representations, metric families, metric formulations (soft vs. hard), and thresholding strategies. In this paper, we formalize alignment evaluation as a structured evaluation configuration space through which the influence of these design choices can be systematically analyzed. We further introduce a structured alignment evaluation framework that models interactions between XAI methods,

translated_title: 解构评估者：配置如何塑造可解释AI中的一致性评估
translated_abstract: 可解释AI（XAI）的评估从根本上需要以人为中心的评估方式，即评估解释是否与人类推理和专家知识相一致。然而，此类评估通常需要专家驱动的人工验证且难以规模化，因此基于一致性的指标被广泛采用，即通过将归因图与预定义的真值（GT）表示进行比较来进行评估。尽管此类评估广受欢迎，但一致性评估隐含地受到评估过程中多个设计选择的偏差影响，例如真值表示、指标族、指标形式（软性 vs. 硬性）以及阈值化策略。在本文中，我们将一致性评估形式化为一个结构化的评估配置空间，通过该空间可以系统地分析这些设计选择的影响。我们进一步引入了一个结构化的一致性评估框架，用于建模XAI方法与（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将可解释AI中基于一致性的评估形式化为结构化配置空间，系统揭示了真值表示、指标族、软/硬指标形式和阈值策略等设计选择对评估结果的隐含偏差影响。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes alignment-based XAI evaluation as a structured configuration space, systematically revealing how design choices—such as ground-truth representations, metric families, soft vs. hard metric formulations, and thresholding strategies—implicitly bias evaluation outcomes.
